full_text_en:
Yunnan Fuyun Logistics Co., Ltd. v. China Life Property Insurance Company Limited Qujing Central Sub-Branch — dispute over property loss insurance contract

Ruling Summary

1. The Compensation Agreement and Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation reached by the parties concerning the amount of property insurance loss constitute an admission of the amount of property damage compensation, represent the true intention of the parties, and are valid civil juristic acts.

2. An insurance contract is formed upon the mutual expression of intent by the parties, i.e., when both parties agree to be bound by specific terms, the insurance contract is concluded. The issuance of an insurance policy is an act of the insurer, aimed at confirming the content of the insurance contract, facilitating the parties' awareness of the contract terms, and producing evidentiary effect. According to Article 13, paragraph 1 of the Insurance Law, which provides that "where an applicant makes a request for insurance and the insurer agrees to underwrite the insurance, an insurance contract is formed. The insurer shall promptly issue an insurance policy or other insurance certificate to the applicant, and shall set out in the insurance policy or other insurance certificate all terms agreed upon by both parties," the issuance of an insurance policy is not a necessary formality for the formation of an insurance contract.

3. The insurance premium is the consideration for the insured to obtain insurance coverage. According to Article 13, paragraph 3 of the Insurance Law, which provides that "a lawfully formed insurance contract shall take effect upon its formation. The applicant and the insurer may agree to attach conditions or a time period to the validity of the contract," an insurance contract may expressly stipulate that the payment of the insurance premium is a condition for the contract to take effect. If the insurance contract provides that the contract takes effect upon payment of the insurance premium, the insurer shall not be liable for losses occurring before the payment of the insurance premium.

Civil Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

(2013) Min Shen Zi No. 1567

Reapplying Applicant (Appellant at Second Instance, Plaintiff at First Instance, Counterclaim Defendant at First Instance): Yunnan Fuyun Logistics Co., Ltd. Domicile: Room B, Third Floor, Yinjing Building, No. 239 Guanxing Road, Guanshang Central Area, Guandu District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

Legal Representative: Liu Yonghong, General Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Huang Tao, lawyer of Yunnan Huang Tao Law Firm.

Respondent (Appellant at Second Instance, Defendant at First Instance, Counterclaim Plaintiff at First Instance): China Life Property Insurance Company Limited Qujing Central Sub-Branch. Domicile: No. 277 Qilin East Road, Qilin District, Qujing City, Yunnan Province.

Responsible Person: Zhang Dongsong, General Manager of the Sub-Branch.

Agent ad litem: Zou Zhou, female, born May 14, 1984, Han ethnicity, employee of the Sub-Branch, residing at No. 52 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

Agent ad litem: Li Yuqiang, lawyer of Yunnan Zhenyu Law Firm.

The reapplying applicant, Yunnan Fuyun Logistics Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Fuyun Company), applied to this Court for retrial of the civil judgment (2012) Yun Gao Min Er Zhong Zi No. 110 rendered by the Yunnan High People's Court in the case of dispute over property loss insurance contract with the respondent, China Life Property Insurance Company Limited Qujing Central Sub-Branch (hereinafter referred to as Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company). This Court lawfully formed a collegial panel to review the case, and the review has now concluded.

Fuyun Company, alleging that it had established a cargo transportation insurance relationship with Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company, and that during the process of claiming insurance compensation after the occurrence of an insured event, it was defrauded by Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company and the agreement signed was manifestly unfair, filed an action with the Qujing Intermediate People's Court of Yunnan Province, requesting the court to: 1. Rescind the Compensation Agreement and Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation signed by Fuyun Company and Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company on August 30, 2011; 2. Order Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company to pay Fuyun Company insurance compensation of RMB 2,372,007 (after deducting RMB 498,800 already paid, the remaining insurance compensation owed to Fuyun Company is RMB 1,873,207).

The Qujing Intermediate People's Court of Yunnan Province rendered a civil judgment (2011) Qu Zhong Min Chu Zi No. 114 on January 11, 2012, holding that: Pursuant to Articles 10, 13, and 14 of the Insurance Law of the PRC, Fuyun Company had insured cargo for road transport covering 36 vehicles, including trucks Yun AA7753 and Yun A1480, by using a mobile phone to make a telephone application. Due to objective reasons, Zeng Chao, an employee of Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company, made manual notes of the oral application and later made supplementary entries. On August 18, 2011, Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company issued to Fuyun Company the Domestic Road Transport Cargo Insurance Policy with the policy number ending in 16, and on August 29, 2011, issued an invoice for the collection of insurance premium of RMB 7,630.85. In this regard, it should be held that the Domestic Road Transport Cargo Insurance Contract signed by the parties was formed. On the day of dispatch of the vehicles Yun AA7753 and Yun A1480 listed in the schedule attached to Policy Number 16, a fire broke out in the left rear wheel, causing the vehicles and the cargo loaded on them, being 660 bales (33,000 kilograms) of 2010 Argentina/BIF strips, to be burned, resulting in a total cargo loss of RMB 2,372,007. The Motor Vehicle Insurance Claim Record (Substituted Copy) submitted by Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company recorded that Huang Hecan reported the incident at 22:54:06 on August 16, 2011. Both the motor vehicle and cargo insurance were with this insurance company, which should have been aware of the burning of the cargo at the same time. On the day after the incident, i.e., at 9:34 a.m. on August 17, 2011, Fuyun Company transferred the insurance premium via online banking to the bank card of Zeng Chao, an employee of Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company. In accordance with the terms agreed in the Domestic Road Transport Cargo Insurance Policy signed by both parties and the relevant provisions of the Insurance Law of the PRC, the insurance company shall not be liable for insurance. Although Fuyun Company did not receive the Road Transport Cargo Insurance Clauses and did not sign or seal the policy ending in 16, it had a long-standing insurance business relationship with Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company and actually received the policy; therefore, it should have been aware of the contents of the Road Transport Cargo Insurance Clauses and the policy. The Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation signed and sealed by Fuyun Company on August 30, 2011, and the Compensation Agreement signed with Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company on the same day, were reached through voluntary negotiation by both parties. Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company, in accordance with the agreement, made a one-time full settlement and paid the agreed compensation amount. Pursuant to Article 2, paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Evidence in Civil Proceedings, although Fuyun Company claimed that it was defrauded by Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company, resulting in the conclusion of an agreement with manifestly unfair content against its true intention, and Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company claimed that Fuyun Company fraudulently accepted the ex gratia compensation agreement and induced it to sign the domestic road transport cargo insurance contract, constituting fraud and a material mistake, neither party had sufficient evidence to prove these claims. Both parties should bear the adverse consequences. The judgment: 1. Dismissed Fuyun Company's claims; 2. Dismissed Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company's counterclaims.

Fuyun Company, dissatisfied with the above civil judgment, appealed to the Yunnan High People's Court, arguing: 1. The first instance court's findings of fact were unclear. The first instance court did not accept the Yunnan Province Non-Auto Insurance Major Case Report submitted by Fuyun Company, which evidenced the basic fact that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company acknowledged the establishment of the cargo insurance contract with Fuyun Company and the occurrence of the insured event, and reported this to its superior company. 2. The first instance court erred in the application of law. This included: the first instance court did not find that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company should fulfill the obligation of clear explanation under Article 17 of the Insurance Law, did not find that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company no longer had the right to terminate the contract or other defenses and the right to refuse compensation, and that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company's compensation of only RMB 498,800 was manifestly unfair. Request: Set aside the original judgment, amend the judgment to support its claims in the main action, and order Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company to bear the court costs of the first and second instances.

Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company, dissatisfied with the above civil judgment, appealed to the Yunnan High People's Court, arguing: 1. The first instance judgment omitted and incorrectly found facts. This included: the fact that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company and Fuyun Company signed and performed Policy Number 13; the internal policy entry time for Policy Number 16 by Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company was August 29, 2011, not August 17, 2011; on the morning of August 17, 2011, when Fuyun Company's staff delivered the insurance application form and transferred the insurance premium, they did not inform Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company's staff of the occurrence of a traffic accident. 2. Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company's signing of the Compensation Agreement and Policy Number 16 were both based on a material mistake. Fuyun Company, by fraudulently accepting the Compensation Agreement, induced Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company to sign Policy Number 16, which clearly constitutes fraud. Fuyun Company should return all ex gratia compensation paid by Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company. Request: Set aside the second item of the original judgment, amend the judgment to support its counterclaims at first instance.

The Yunnan High People's Court rendered a civil judgment (2012) Yun Gao Min Er Zhong Zi No. 110 on June 18, 2011 (note: the date appears inconsistent; likely a typo in original text, but we keep as is), holding that: The main issues for dispute at second instance were whether the first instance court correctly found that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company was not liable for insurance and correctly dismissed both parties' claims for rescission due to insufficient evidence. 1. The parties had a long-standing insurance business relationship and had established a certain degree of mutual trust. Pursuant to Article 13, paragraph 1 of the Insurance Law of the PRC, at 5:36 p.m. on August 16, 2011, Lv Dongfen, an employee of Fuyun Company, called Zeng Chao, an employee of Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company, on her mobile phone and orally provided the name, quantity, unit price, and amount of the cargo to be insured, with dispatch time being that day, i.e., August 16, 2011, at 0:00. This act constituted a clear request for insurance by Fuyun Company as the applicant. Zeng Chao of Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company made manual notes of the oral application. As it was near the end of the workday, the policy was not issued that day; it was intended to be entered the following day. This act constituted Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company's agreement to underwrite the insurance. In this case, at the time of the application by Fuyun Company, it was near the end of the workday, and Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company also did not issue the policy due to the time. Although according to law, Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company, as the insurer, should promptly issue an insurance policy or other insurance certificate to the applicant Fuyun Company, the law does not specify a precise time limit, and the parties had no corresponding agreement. Therefore, it cannot be concluded that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company, as the insurer, violated any statutory or contractual obligation and should bear liability for failing to issue the policy promptly. Pursuant to Articles 10, 11, and 13, paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Insurance Law of the PRC, the parties in this case reached an agreement on the insurance content orally stated by Lv Dongfen of Fuyun Company and manually noted by Zeng Chao of Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company. However, they did not reach an agreement on the specific details regarding the payment of insurance premiums, the time when insurance liability commenced, and other matters. It was not until August 17, 2011, that Fuyun Company filled out the Domestic Cargo Transport Insurance Application Form to further negotiate the relevant rights and obligations. In the "Special Provisions" column of the application form, it was stated: "The applicant shall pay the insurance premium at the time of conclusion of the insurance contract. The insurer shall not be liable for any insurance accident occurring before the premium is fully paid." Subsequently, in the "Applicant's Declaration" column, the seal of Fuyun Company was affixed, and it was stated: "The insurer has clearly explained the contents of the Domestic Transport Insurance Clauses (Railway/Highway/Waterway/Air) (including the exemption clauses) to the applicant. The applicant fully understands the contents of the clauses (including the exemption clauses) and the insurer's explanation. The information filled in above is true, and the applicant agrees to use this application form as the basis for concluding the insurance contract." The insurance policy ending in 16 also contained the same Special Provisions as above. The policy ending in 16 was one of the pieces of evidence submitted by Fuyun Company to the first instance court as its own third set of evidence. Fuyun Company used this policy to assert that there was a cargo transport insurance contract relationship between the parties and to claim that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company should bear corresponding insurance liability. Accordingly, it can be confirmed that the parties, through the application form and the insurance policy, mutually agreed on the term that "the applicant shall pay the insurance premium at the time of conclusion of the insurance contract. The insurer shall not be liable for any insurance accident occurring before the premium is fully paid." Both parties shall perform this agreement accordingly. The case establishes that the insured event involving vehicles Yun AA7753 and Yun A1480 occurred at 22:35 on August 16, 2011. The first payment of the relevant insurance premium by Fuyun Company was made at 9:34 a.m. on August 17, 2011. Therefore, according to the relevant agreement between the parties, Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company is not liable for insurance. Although Fuyun Company did not receive the policy ending in 16 until August 30, 2011, the application form filled out and sealed by Fuyun Company on August 17, 2011, already stated that "the applicant shall pay the insurance premium at the time of conclusion of the insurance contract. The insurer shall not be liable for any insurance accident occurring before the premium is fully paid." Fuyun Company's current request for Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company to bear insurance liability is inconsistent with the content stated in its own application form; therefore, it should not be supported. 2. Both parties had no dispute as to the authenticity of the policy ending in 16, which was issued and sealed by Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company. Although the policy did not bear the seal of Fuyun Company, Fuyun Company claimed that it was not customary for the insured to seal the policy, and the parties only disputed whether there were grounds for rescission of the policy. On August 30, 2011, the parties signed the Compensation Agreement, which stated: "...After negotiation, the parties have reached a one-time compensation agreement for the loss: 1. Party A (Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company) shall compensate Party B (Fuyun Company) for the cargo insurance loss arising from this accident in the amount of RMB 498,800; 2. The salvage value of the cargo shall be disposed of by Party B in accordance with tobacco regulations; 3. The compensation for the cargo loss from this accident shall be settled finally and completely." On the same day, Fuyun Company signed and sealed the Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation, which stated: "...Policy No. 16 was damaged in an incident on August 16, 2011, and has now been disposed of. Our unit agrees to accept the result of your company's handling, with the compensation amount (lowercase) RMB 498,800, ..." On September 15, 2011, Fuyun Company received the compensation payment and issued a Receipt for Compensation. From the contents and performance of the Compensation Agreement and Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation, it can be confirmed that the parties, after negotiation, agreed that the compensation for the cargo loss from this accident would be finally settled. Both parties now claim to have been defrauded by the other party, alleging manifest unfairness or material mistake, and request the rescission of the Compensation Agreement, Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation, or the policy ending in 16. However, neither party can submit corresponding evidence to prove their claims; therefore, both parties' respective claims are not adopted. In summary, the grounds of appeal of both Fuyun Company and Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company are untenable. The original judgment correctly found the facts and properly applied the law, and should be affirmed. Accordingly, pursuant to Article 153, paragraph 1, item (1) of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the judgment: Appeal dismissed, original judgment affirmed.

Fuyun Company applied to this Court for retrial, arguing: 1. The first and second instance courts' dismissal of both parties' requests to rescind the Compensation Agreement and Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation constituted procedural error and incorrect application of law. 2. Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company should bear insurance compensation liability in this case. The first and second instance courts both objectively found that the Domestic Road Transport Cargo Insurance Contract signed by the parties was formed, but then, relying on the Insurance Law and the Road Transport Cargo Insurance Clauses, found that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company was not liable for insurance. This constitutes an error in the application of law. Request: 1. Set aside the civil judgment (2011) Qu Zhong Min Chu Zi No. 114 of the Qujing Intermediate People's Court and the civil judgment (2012) Yun Gao Min Er Zhong Zi No. 110 of the Yunnan High People's Court; 2. Order Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company to pay Fuyun Company insurance compensation of RMB 1,873,207; 3. Order Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company to bear the court costs of the first and second instances.

This Court holds that: 1. The first and second instance courts' dismissal of both parties' requests to rescind the Compensation Agreement and Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation was not improper. The Compensation Agreement and Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation reached by the parties in this case constitute an admission by the parties of the amount of property damage compensation, represent their true intentions, and are valid civil juristic acts. Although both parties raised requests to rescind the Compensation Agreement and Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation, neither party adduced evidence regarding the grounds for rescission. Article 57 of the General Principles of the Civil Law provides: "A civil juristic act shall be legally binding from the time of its formation. Unless the law provides otherwise or the other party agrees, the actor shall not alter or revoke it." According to the above provision, the Compensation Agreement and Freight Insurance Compensation Confirmation signed by Fuyun Company and Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company shall be protected by law, and both parties shall be bound by the agreement. 2. Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company should not compensate Fuyun Company for the remaining cargo loss of RMB 1,873,207. First, the insurance contract relationship between Fuyun Company and Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company was formed and valid. The first and second instance courts' finding that the insurance contract was formed was not improper. Second, the insurance premium is the consideration for the insured to obtain insurance coverage. According to Article 13, paragraph 3 of the Insurance Law, which provides that "a lawfully formed insurance contract shall take effect upon its formation. The applicant and the insurer may agree to attach conditions or a time period to the validity of the contract," the "Special Provisions" in the Domestic Cargo Transport Insurance Application Form submitted by Fuyun Company to the insurance company, stating that "the applicant shall pay the insurance premium at the time of conclusion of the insurance contract. The insurer shall not be liable for any insurance accident occurring before the premium is fully paid. If the applicant fails to pay the full premium within 15 days after the commencement of insurance liability, the insurer has the right to terminate the insurance contract," constitute a contract with an attached condition precedent. Since the insurance contract in this case agreed that it would take effect upon payment of the insurance premium, the insurer is not liable for losses occurring before the payment of the premium by the applicant. In summary, Fuyun Company's request that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company bear insurance liability is inconsistent with the content stated in its own application form, and this Court does not support it. Fuyun Company's claim that Life Insurance Property Insurance Qujing Company did not fulfill its obligation to clearly explain the contents of the special provisions to it is not accepted by this Court.

In conclusion, Fuyun Company's application for retrial does not meet the circumstances provided in items (2) and (6) of Article 200 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC. Pursuant to Article 204, paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, this Court rules as follows:

The application for retrial of Yunnan Fuyun Logistics Co., Ltd. is dismissed.

Presiding Judge: Yang Lichu

Acting Judge: He Bo

Acting Judge: Li Shengye
